PayProAPIKeyCredential.title: PayPro API Key
PayProAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Generate an API key in your approved PayPro account's dashboard and paste it here. NoClick sends it as a bearer token to api.paypro.nl. Use a test key to test workflows before connecting a live key.

body.description: Documented PayPro JSON fields; omitted optional fields are left unchanged.

amount.description: The amount that the customer will have to pay.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: The currency of the payment. Only 'EUR' is supported.
currency.title: Currency

description.description: The description of the payment. This will be shown to your customer and will be visible in the dashboard.
description.title: Description

return_url.description: The URL where the customer will be send to after the payment has been processed.
return_url.title: Return Url

cancel_url.description: The URL where the customer will be send to after the payment has been canceled by the customer.
cancel_url.title: Cancel Url

pay_methods.description: The allowed pay methods of the payment. If only one pay method is specified, it will be set as the payment pay method. Cannot be used together with a `mandate`.
pay_methods.title: Pay Methods

metadata.description: You can put in random data that you like to save alongside the payment. When you fetch the payment this will be returned in the `metadata` field.
metadata.title: Metadata

customer.description: ID of the customer that pays. This field is optional, if nothing is given we create a new Customer. Cannot be used together with a `mandate`.
customer.title: Customer

mandate.description: ID of the mandate for payment
mandate.title: Mandate

setup_mandate.description: Indicates if the payment should create a mandate after it has been paid. This allows to setup recurring payments without the need to use a `Subscription` or `InstallmentPlan`. Needs the `customer` parameter to be set as well. Cannot be used together with a `mandate`.
setup_mandate.title: Setup Mandate

locale.description: Specifies the language to be used for the payment pages shown to the customer. If no locale or an invalid locale is specified we will ignore it and choose the locale based on the account settings or the locale used by the customer.
locale.title: Locale

body.description: Documented PayPro JSON fields; omitted optional fields are left unchanged.

amount.description: The amount that will be refunded to the customer. This can be an amount lower than the total amount to do a partial refund. You can't refund more than the total amount of the original payment.
amount.title: Amount

description.description: The description of the refund. This will be shown to your customer and will be visible in the dashboard.
description.title: Description

account_holder_name.description: Name of the account holder of the account where the refund will be credited. This is a required field for the pay methods 'bancontact' and 'creditcard'. For other pay methods we will use the orginal customer information provided by the pay method to do the refund.
account_holder_name.title: Account Holder Name

iban.description: IBAN of the account where the refund will be credited. required field for the pay methods 'bancontact' and 'creditcard'. For other pay methods we will use the orginal customer information provided by the pay method to do the refund.
iban.title: Iban

metadata.description: You can put in random data that you like to save alongside the refund. When you fetch the refund this will be returned in the `metadata` field.
metadata.title: Metadata

PayProCreateSubscription.description: Create a subscription using the customer authorization-payment flow.

customer.description: ID of the customer that subscribes. Cannot be used together with a `mandate`.
customer.title: Customer

description.description: Description of the subscription. This will be shown to customers and in the PayPro dashboard
description.title: Description

currency.description: The currency of the subscription. Only 'EUR' is supported
currency.title: Currency

start_at.description: Date when the subscription will start. When left empty, it will start at creation
start_at.title: Start At

cancel_at.description: Date at which the subscription will be canceled. When left empty, the subscription will be active until manually canceled
cancel_at.title: Cancel At

expire_at.description: Date at which the subscription link will expire if the subscription has not started yet. When left empty, the subscription link will not expire
expire_at.title: Expire At

pay_methods.description: Pay methods that can be used to start the subscription. Using this creates the subscription with the `authorization` flow and will start the subscription when the first payment is paid. Use the checkout link in the `links` field to redirect the customer. Cannot be used together with a `mandate`.
pay_methods.title: Pay Methods

payment_details.description: Fields to be passed to the authorization payment.

period.description: Settings for when new periods should be created and with which amounts

first_period.description: Settings for when the first period should be created and with what amount
